change.title: pr-80528-flat
change.description: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: Computed `config` copy is discarded; raw monitor.config is sent
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds `config` with a human-readable `schedule_type` (lines 160-162) but then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` on line 168, so the copy is dead code and the occurrence context carries the raw schedule_type. This is carried over unchanged from the old mark_failed.py, so the refactor does not introduce it. Either return `config` or drop the copy. Changing it alters the event payload, so do it separately from this move.

contracts.action: Move the threshold and occurrence logic out of mark_failed.py into incidents.py and incident_occurrence.py. Rename mark_failed_threshold to try_incident_threshold and create_issue_platform_occurrence to create_incident_occurrence. Move SimpleCheckIn to types.py.
contracts.equivalent_path: The previous in-module mark_failed_threshold and create_issue_platform_occurrence in mark_failed.py.
contracts.before_after: The moved bodies are identical to the removed ones. mark_failed still calls the threshold function after refresh_from_db, as before. The produce_occurrence_to_kafka and IssueOccurrence imports stay lazy inside the function, so tests that patch sentry.issues.producer.produce_occurrence_to_kafka still intercept the call.
contracts.failure_mode: A leftover importer of the removed names would fail with an ImportError. A grep of the repo found no references to mark_failed_threshold or the old create_issue_platform_occurrence in the monitors code. The only other function with that name is the uptime one, which is a separate function. The only imports from logic.mark_failed are of mark_failed itself.

summary: This is a behaviour-preserving refactor. The code is moved and renamed, and `SimpleCheckIn` goes to types.py. I found no dangling references to the removed names. The tests patch `sentry.issues.producer`, and the lazy imports are kept, so they still work. The only finding is a dead `config` copy in `get_monitor_environment_context`, which comes from the old code.
